title: Warsaw Ghetto Uprising
note: Armed Jewish civilian resistance in occupied Warsaw against Nazi SS deportation forces between 19 April and 16 May 1943, representing the largest single revolt by Jewish resistance fighters during the Holocaust.

title: Kristallnacht (November Pogroms)
note: State-sponsored pogrom across Germany, annexed Austria, and the Sudetenland on 9–10 November 1938, destroying hundreds of synagogues, looting thousands of Jewish businesses, and sending over 30,000 Jewish men to concentration camps.

title: Sophie Scholl
note: German student and political activist in Munich who was a leading member of the non-violent White Rose resistance movement against Nazi dictatorship and wartime genocide, executed by guillotine in February 1943.

title: Attack on Pearl Harbor
note: Surprise military strike by the Imperial Japanese Navy on the US naval base at Oahu, Hawaii, directly drawing the United States into World War II and prompting Hitler's declaration of war on the US four days later.
